fit.observations: 1981–2016 system astrometry; Voyager 2 and HST are key Naiad data. Tentative Marchis Naiad measurements excluded because residuals large.
fit.model: nep090 integrated ICRF Neptune-system-barycentric orbits, weighted least squares; Neptune J2/J4, Triton, planets and Sun perturbations; fixed pole, DE435, NEP081; fitted Voyager systematic camera bias.
fit.GM_limit: Formal post-fit 1 sigma; borderline sensitivity; no Naiad/Thalassa mass priors. Removing Voyager increases errors >60%. Other inner-moon masses constrained by priors, not equivalent measurements.
fit.radius_source: Table 5 adopts Karkoschka 2003 Voyager imaging radius; not new pixel measurement or silent catalogue replacement.
fit.density_limit: Derived using adopted image size and fitted GM; propagated radius/mass errors, not direct sensor, local chemistry or porosity measurement.

Table7_Naiad.reference: Local Laplace plane; not equator or scene camera plane.

fit.mean_element_limit: 900-year integration summarized by precessing ellipse; authors deliberately assign no element errors because fit-to-integration errors are not observational uncertainty. Digits do not establish current distance or exact scene registration.

resonance.type: Fourth-order inclination resonance involving Naiad node; not spin resonance.
resonance.mass_sensitivity: Changing Thalassa GM to 0.03 km3/s2 (+1 sigma) gives about46deg/1.7yr; not universal fixed constants.
resonance.conjunction: Simplified integrated geometry south,south,north,north offsets; historical lower-order captures and Triton-related origins remain interpretations.

models.tidal: MacCullagh ellipsoid gravity plus tides and assumed synchronous rotation; Drucker-Prager with assumed35deg friction. Nominal ≥10kPa cohesion, densityaround1.3g/cm3/less elongation alternatives; conditional strength requirements, not measured cohesion or verified imminent disruption.

models.sesquinary: REBOUND/TRACE/ReboundX, Neptune/Naiad/Thalassa/Despina and test particles only; J2/J4, initial NAIF SPICE states; other moons and solar tides neglected. Nominal million orbital periods about800yr. Initial10m projectile20km/s, strength1–10MPa.
models.ejecta: Fixed10m particles with target density; random hemisphere launch; no particle-particle interactions/collision search. HH11 crater scaling uses DART/Dimorphos simulation parameters as modelling proxy, not Naiad measured material. Mass/momentum adjusted, angular momentum not perfectly conserved.1MPa run haltedaround200yr due growth.
models.interpretation: SeveralMPa protection/possible monolithic fragment are conditional interpretations; not detected interior. Grinding/PR removal/deepfine-regolith alternative scenarios need more sophisticated modelling. No ring/torus detection or regolith thickness adopted.
